raw_logs.capture: caller-owned stdout/stderr capture; native file descriptors are not redirected by this wrapper

observation_scope: after completed sim.update returns and before BaseEnv auto-reset; sticky native flags cover all substeps, sampled contact/constraint counts cover the last substep only
failure_policy: capacity/collision-loss or unclassified overflow bits raise before auto-reset; ITERATIONS/LS_ITERATIONS are recorded convergence-budget events, not dropped contacts

train.scope: after sim.update returns, before BaseEnv auto-reset; sticky overflow flags cover the full control interval, contact maxima sample its last physical substep
train.control_clock_scope: clock read immediately before/after the first two completed sim.update calls; no individual substep clock read is claimed

overflow_masks.meaning: ITERATIONS/LS_ITERATIONS are convergence budgets; other installed enum bits indicate capacity/collision loss. Flags are sticky until native reset.

counter_scope.nefc: constraints per world; njmax is a hard per-world limit
